Warnings by severity

Ordered procedure

  2. Use the labeled primary route; keep the alternate available.
  3. Confirm completion with the accountable person.

Checklist & local facts

  • Household members accounted for
  • Assistive equipment ready
  • Destination written down

Dense paragraph

Keep sentences direct, preserve meaningful labels, and put prerequisites before actions. A full URL must remain legible and wrap safely: https://example.invalid/emergency-preparedness/very-long-reference-address.
